pay.evidence: The BDes curriculum has a four-level structure leading to a gradual movement from general, foundational courses at level 1 to more specialized inputs at level 4
As the student moves upwards from level 1 to level 2, the student graduates to choosing between courses which offer different kinds of skills from soft to hard
The courses at level 1 would help the students to choose the mix of skills they prefer to acquire
At level 3, it is hoped that the student is ready to fine tune a certain mix or a set of skills into a specialization
At Level 4, the student employs all that has been gained regarding skills and understanding and applies or uses them in independent projects
